name: WMA Tract Segmentation with ROIs
summary: Segments a tractogram into tracts by keeping streamlines that connect user-specified pairs of ROIs from an ROI directory, using compiled MATLAB wma_tools, and outputs a white matter classification.
description: Runs the compiled wma_tools function bsc_SegROIfromPairStringList_v3 on the tractogram and the ROI directory: for each line of roiPairs it combines the listed ROIs into two endpoint regions (optionally inflated) and assigns to a tract the streamlines that connect them. Use it to extract specific connections from a whole-brain tractogram after generating ROIs. Needs a tractogram and ROIs in the same space. The surface-generation step in main reads an 'atlas' config key that this App does not provide.

inputs.description: Directory of ROI NIfTI files whose numbers are referenced in roiPairs.
inputs.requirements: Must be in the same space as the tractogram.

outputs.description: White matter classification (classification.mat) with one tract per ROI pair.

parameters.description: Pairs of ROI sets to segment between: each line is one tract, with the two endpoint sets separated by ';' and each set listing atlas/ROI indices separated by spaces.
Odd whole-number kernel size used to smooth (inflate) each ROI with MATLAB smooth3 before segmentation; values above 1 inflate the ROI and 0 disables inflation.
